notes: Criterion-3 hidden-bug experiment per finding_ablation_delta_zero.md (2026-05-22 update). The planted failure lives in mockTodos.ts:89 — `invoices.find((d) => d.id === id)` was changed to `... === id + 1`. fetchInvoiceById(1) therefore returns invoice 2. Component (src/main.tsx) is COMPLETELY CLEAN — no visible bug in candidateComponent. Spec asserts `Body of invoice 1` is visible after clicking #1; invoice 2's body renders instead so the locator times out. Designed to stress the with-snapshot vs without-snapshot delta: the agent reading the case has component.tsx (clean) + spec.ts only — mockTodos.ts is NOT in candidatePaths. Without snapshot, the agent has no information path to the bug source. With snapshot, the agent sees InvoiceFields rendered { id: 2, title: 'Invoice 2', ... } despite URL invoiceId=1 — the discrepancy is observable only at runtime, only in the tree. minimumConfidence intentionally set to 'low' because the snapshotless variant has no source-level smoking gun; any correct classification at any confidence counts as a hit. If the snapshotted variant systematically achieves higher confidence than the snapshotless variant on cases like this, the ablation byConfidence breakdown will detect it.
